galleries.title: Photographs
galleries.blurb: Gene and his shipmates ashore in Hawaii, during his service at Pearl Harbor before December 7, 1941. Several snapshots are captioned on the reverse in his own hand.

items.caption: On the lawn at Honolulu.
items.alt: A young sailor in dress whites sits on the grass beneath a tree, a 1930s car parked on the street behind him.

items.caption: Among the palms.
items.alt: A sailor in dress whites stands amid dense tropical foliage.

items.caption: “Me and a couple of lumber jacks from California.”
items.alt: Three sailors in dress whites stand arm in arm before a Honolulu building framed by palms.
items.caption_source: Gene's caption, written on the reverse.

items.caption: Three shipmates in Honolulu.
items.alt: Three sailors in dress whites stand together before a building and palms.

items.caption: Above the harbor.
items.alt: Two sailors in whites lean on a barbed-wire fence above the water, hills across the bay behind them.

items.caption: Along the waterfront, Honolulu.
items.alt: Two sailors rest against a stone embankment beside a canal, a street, lamp post, and hills behind them.
